The settings gear in the popup was a stroked outline, which at 16 pixels stopped reading as a gear.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The gear badge in the popup is the app's own filled glyph.** It was drawn as a line icon with a 2px stroke on a 24px grid, squeezed into 16 pixels — at that size the strokes merge and it renders as a dark blob rather than a gear. It is now the same filled path the web UI's own sidebar uses, which is also what the design language asks for: every glyph here is a filled solid shape, never a drawn outline, so it sits at the same weight as the filled badges and switches around it.

## 📋 Notes

- Nothing else changed. 1.5.0's release notes describe everything this build does.
